newsitem.title: INDIA: India castor futures market closed for festival.
newsitem.headline: India castor futures market closed for festival.

text.p: Indian castorseed futures market was closed on Monday for a Hindu festival. It will reopen on Tuesday.
On Friday, castorseed June delivery fell to 1,196/1,197 rupees after rising to 1,200 rupees as operators booked profits ahead of the long weekend.

Groundnut oil remained steady at 339/340 rupees per 10 kg amid limited arrivals of 60/70 tonnes while physical buying was at a low ebb. In Rajkot spot groundnut oil was steady at 518/520 rupees per 15 kg.
